# Tommaso Scalici

> Senior Software Engineer & Prog Metal Musician bridging software engineering and progressive metal. Based in Palermo, Italy.

## Overview
Senior Software Engineer specialized in Flutter, React, Astro, and Cloud AI, with an enterprise background in .NET, Azure, and SharePoint. Combines engineering rigor with artistic creativity from progressive metal composition.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: [Flutter](https://flutter.dev), [React](https://react.dev), [Astro](https://astro.build), [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com)
- **Backend & Cloud**: .NET, C#, Azure, SharePoint, Cloud Architectures
- **Artificial Intelligence**: Cloud AI integration, LLM-based tools, agentic workflows
- **Music & Production**: Prog Metal composition, Soundtrack design, 7-string guitar

## Featured Projects
- [Tax Code Flutter](https://tommasoscalici.dev/apps/taxcode/privacy-policy/): Italian fiscal code calculator built with Flutter focusing on clean architecture and UI/UX.
- [Smart Spotify Playlist Curator](https://github.com/TommasoScalici/smart-spotify-playlist-curator): AI-driven tool for organizing and curating Spotify playlists.
- [MathExtensions](https://github.com/TommasoScalici/MathExtensions): Specialized C# extension library for high-performance mathematical operations.
- [MVVMExtensions](https://github.com/TommasoScalici/MVVMExtensions): Lightweight library simplifying the Model-View-ViewModel pattern in .NET applications.
- [tommasoscalici.dev](https://tommasoscalici.dev): Personal portfolio website built with Astro 7, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.
